findings.message: 19.P7.host-review-surfaces describes ticket validation as accepting ENGINE_GATE_CODES plus declared mechanical codes and requires test_gate_bypass_does_not_demote_surface to exercise an accepted mechanical bypass. This contradicts 19.P7.host-mechanical-check and the Phase 7 SEVERITY contract, which explicitly exclude host mechanical codes from gate_bypass. The committed validator at chupa/tickets.py:45 accepts only ENGINE_GATE_CODES. The successor must cite this contradictory entry, so it cannot be authored without inventing a resolution.
findings.paved_road: Repair and commit the Records and Tests clauses of 19.P7.host-review-surfaces to agree with the mechanical-code bypass prohibition, then rerun this seeding ticket.
